name: FFS_REPORT_CHART
description: Used to store charts for custom report.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for custom report chart.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type Of Visualization For The Chat.

columns.name: REPORT_ID
columns.description: Id of the report for the chart.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the custom report chart.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Detailed description about the chart.

columns.name: DASHBOARD
columns.description: Whether To Show On Report For The Dashboard.

columns.name: CID
columns.description: Chart template id of the report.

columns.name: HINT
columns.description: Hint for the report chart, to show in config menu.

columns.name: CHART_SIZE
columns.description: Initial size of chart window on the screen.

columns.name: TITLEX
columns.description: Title for X-axis. Valid only for area, column, line chart.

columns.name: TITLEY
columns.description: Title for Y-axis - Valid only for area, column, line chart.

columns.name: MIN
columns.description: Minimum value available. Valid only for gauge.

columns.name: MAX
columns.description: Maximum value available. Valid only for gauge.

columns.name: YELLOW_BORDER
columns.description: Limit value for yellow area. Valid only for gauge.

columns.name: RED_BORDER
columns.description: Limit value for red area. Valid only for gauge.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Column/row of custom report data from which labels are taken.

columns.name: VALUE_FROM
columns.description: Column of custom report data from which chart data is taken.

columns.name: VALUE_TO
columns.description: Column of custom report data from which chart data is taken - for area, column, line we taken range of columns.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
